post.description: Supports initialize, tools/list, tools/call, resources/list, and resources/read JSON-RPC-style requests. Tools are read-only and require explicit user approval before any external contact outside this API. Current tools include get_company_overview, list_services, match_project_scope, prepare_project_inquiry, prepare_rfq_brief, list_service_areas, get_procurement_profile, ask_agent_concierge, and read_public_resource.

x-a2b-approval-requirements: No public endpoint sends email, submits forms, calls phone numbers, or creates commitments.
The public agent concierge has no database, credential access, private-system access, model call, or arbitrary tool execution.
Do not send personal data, passwords, API keys, tokens, or secrets to the public agent endpoints.
Agents must ask for explicit user approval before contacting a2b.
Careers, vendors, internships, training, spam, retail shopping, consumer courier, and unrelated requests must not be routed to project inquiry.
High-intent page plan resources are drafts only and must not be treated as published service pages until owner approval.
